titulo: Quiz — Θα ήθελα and the first round
introPt: A table for two, a menu that has not arrived, and a basket of bread nobody asked about.
cenario: A taverna terrace at half past eight in the evening.

dialogo.es: Καλησπέρα. Θα ήθελα ένα τραπέζι για δύο.
dialogo.pt: Good evening. I'd like a table for two.
dialogo.tts: Καλησπέρα. Θα ήθελα ένα τραπέζι για δύο.

dialogo.es: Έξω, παρακαλώ. Θα ήθελα τον κατάλογο.
dialogo.pt: Outside, please. I'd like the menu.
dialogo.tts: Έξω, παρακαλώ. Θα ήθελα τον κατάλογο.

dialogo.es: Αμέσως. Νερό στο τραπέζι, να σας φέρω;
dialogo.pt: Right away. Water on the table, shall I bring some?
dialogo.tts: Αμέσως. Νερό στο τραπέζι, να σας φέρω;

perguntas.pergunta: Why θα ήθελα rather than θέλω at a counter?
opcoes: Θέλω is incorrect Greek
Θέλω lands drier; the conditional is the register the counter expects
Θέλω is only used in writing
Θα ήθελα is shorter
perguntas.explica: Θέλω is perfectly correct. It just arrives flatter in Greek than I want does in English, and the conditional does the work of please before you reach the noun.

perguntas.pergunta: The waiter asks Νερό στο τραπέζι, να σας φέρω; That question is:
opcoes: A formality — the water comes either way
The consent step, and yes means it can go on the bill
A sign that tap water is unavailable
An offer that is always free of charge
perguntas.explica: Nothing may be served and charged without prior consent, bottled water expressly included. The question is the mechanism working.

perguntas.pergunta: A cover charge in Greece is:
opcoes: Lawful if it is printed on the menu
Lawful only at the busiest hours
Prohibited
Left to each region to decide
perguntas.explica: Article 72 of the trading rules bans κουβέρ outright, at €500 per item. This is the opposite of the Italian coperto, which is lawful when declared.

perguntas.pergunta: Ταβέρνα, εστιατόριο, ουζερί and ψησταριά are:
opcoes: Four legal licence classes
Trade custom — a forecast of the card and the room, not a licence class
Regional words for exactly the same thing
Grades set by the tourism ministry
perguntas.explica: The legislation groups them all as mass catering under one regime. The names survive because they are useful, not because they are official.

perguntas.pergunta: Where does the price list have to be, by law?
opcoes: Only inside, at the till
In Greek, visible at the entrance and before you order, with tax included
On request, in the language of the customer
Nowhere — posting it is voluntary
perguntas.explica: Articles 70 and 71: €1,000 where the list is missing, €500 for an item charged above what is listed. You can check it from the pavement.
